transcript: Hello, and thank you for calling the information line for the lifeguard division for the city of Oceanside. Please choose from the following options for our weather and surf report. Please press 1. Good morning. The following Ocean's Head surf report was recorded on Thursday, September 10 at 8AM. Under clear skies, there is a two to three foot south southwest swell with fair shape. Water temperature is 72 degrees. There's a three mile per hour wind blowing out of the Southeast. Today's tides include a high of 5.2 at 09:33AM, falling to a low of point nine feet at 03:17PM. If you would like any further information on Osha Lifeguard service, please dial 435-4018. Thank you, and have a safe day. No one is available to take your call. Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
